verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms LangGraph nodes/tools can be freely custom-coded (comm-10) and that tool integration exists via MCPAdapter (docs-22), implying developers can define custom tools, but the pack lacks any concrete code example showing typed tool definitions or a 'few lines of code' walkthrough for tool creation. Missing for 10: a documented tool-definition API/decorator with type hints, a minimal code snippet, and independent confirmation of ease-of-use for typed tools.
